infobox.usage: Unlocks the bedroom in apartment 8 on the third floor of the Concordia building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Concordia apartment 8 room key (Conc 8) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the rooms in apartment 8 inside the Concordia building.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text:
Bedroom door in apartment 8 on the third floor of the Concordia building at Streets of Tarkov.

It is also possible to reach the room through a breakthrough from apartment 34.
